listing.name: Yoshi's Cookie NES Recomp
listing.summary: Play Yoshi's Cookie with the official Windows runtime and your matching original NES ROM.

presentation.manual_preparation: Download the official Windows x64 ZIP from upstream Releases and extract the entire archive, including its DLLs and assets. Run YoshisCookieRecomp.exe, use Browse For ROM to select your own matching Yoshi's Cookie (USA) NES ROM, then Play and close normally. Return to Portcove, choose that executable and its extracted folder as the working directory, add the original ROM's full path as one argument, and review the launch details before registering. In Desktop, enter that path on one line without surrounding quotes. This also works when upstream's Skip launcher on boot is enabled; leaving arguments empty requires the launcher to remain enabled. You or upstream handle runtime updates. Remove registration only forgets Portcove's reference; the runtime, original, saves and settings stay in place. Existing Portcove-built installations retain their original contracts.
